address: Pasar 16@Bedok (Bedok South Food Centre), #01-41, 16 Bedok South Road, 460016, Singapore
bio: This stall serves a single dish that is drop-dead perfect every time. Full-bodied wok hei, irresistible aromas and generous toppings like cockles, Chinese sausage, chives and bean sprouts justify the often hour-long wait....
